delivery.smooth1: {{giver}}'s contact waits for you in a back room. He checks the goods silently, then nods. Clean transaction.
delivery.smooth2: You find the recipient after twenty minutes searching the corridors. He looks at the item, then at you. "You're late." He pays anyway.
delivery.tense1: The recipient is there, but not alone. Two guys in the shadows. He asks if you were followed.
delivery.detour1: You arrive at the given address — the place is closed. A note pinned to the door says to go to the level below.
delivery.ambush1: On your way to the delivery, someone bumps past you in the corridor and deliberately knocks over your crate. Heads turn toward you.
delivery.negotiation1: The recipient is there but initially refuses the goods. "Terms have changed." He tries to renegotiate down.

heist.smooth1: You hand the object to {{giver}}. He doesn't even look at it — he already knew what it was. The payment arrives without a word.
heist.ambush1: Someone else was looking for this item. He's there, in the corridor, and he saw you.
heist.smooth2: The handoff goes through. {{giver}} examines the object at length. "This is the one." He pays. But you wonder just how long he'd been waiting for exactly this.
